title: Good-Standing Amount on a Ridgeline Consumer Credit Account
content:
**Definition.** The good-standing amount of a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account is the unpaid minimum plus the late fees posted in the last month plus the interest bridge, rounded to the nearest cent.

- **Latest statement.** The latest statement's figures — its balance, minimum payment due, past-due amount, statement date and due date — are those of the most recent statement issued.
- **In the last month.** A payment or a late fee counts as being in the last month when it is dated less than 1 full month before today. With today 20 May, a line dated 21 April is in the last month and one dated 20 April is not.
- **Unpaid minimum.** The latest statement's minimum payment due less the payments credited in the last month, never below zero.
- **Late fees posted in the last month.** The total of the late fee lines on the account dated in the last month.
- **Interest bridge.** The unpaid minimum multiplied by the account's purchase APR (interest rate schedule) divided by 100 and by the calendar days from the latest statement's due date to today, divided by 365 and rounded to the nearest cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical Card Preferred account, purchase APR 29.99 percent)

| Line | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| Latest statement's minimum payment due | 95.00 | 95.00 |
| Payments credited in the last month | 0.00 | 40.00 |
| Unpaid minimum | 95.00 | 55.00 |
| Late fees posted in the last month | 32.00 | 32.00 |
| Calendar days from the latest due date to today | 12 | 12 |
| Interest bridge | 95.00 multiplied by 29.99, divided by 100, by 12, divided by 365: 0.9366..., rounded 0.94 | 55.00 on the same basis: 0.5422..., rounded 0.54 |
| Good-standing amount | 127.94 | 87.54 |

When the payments credited in the last month reach or exceed the minimum payment due, the unpaid minimum is 0.00 and the interest bridge is 0.00.
